installCommand: bash build/ensure-wasm-build-tools.sh && bash -c 'corepack enable --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && export PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile'
buildCommand: bash -c 'corepack enable --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && export PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH && NITRO_PRESET=vercel pnpm run build'
